title: Robbery of Banco Fonsecas & Burnay, in Póvoa de Santo Adrião, on October 13, 1981
summary: Wikidata item Q111788515, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "robbery carried out by 6 elements of the Forças Populares 25 de Abril, where 2,443,855$90 was stolen, and having been shot in the heart, a popular man, Fernando de Abreu". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
